I'm calculating for the number of genes categorised as "regionally elevated" in the forebrain regions in humans, pigs, and mice.

Starting with humans:
```{r}
sum(180,83,57,110)
```

Then, calculating for pigs:
```{r}
sum(109,157,31,45)
```

Finally, calculating for mice:
```{r}
sum(55,185,60,98)
```

Humans have the greatest number of genes classified as "regionally elevated."
